scripts.build: bun build src/index.js --bundle --format=cjs --platform=browser --charset=utf8 --outfile=dist/index.js --external react --external react-dom --external react-dom/client --external react/jsx-runtime --external @plugin-host
scripts.dev: bun --watch build src/index.js --bundle --format=cjs --platform=browser --charset=utf8 --outfile=dist/index.js --external react --external react-dom --external react-dom/client --external react/jsx-runtime --external @plugin-host
scripts.clean:all: bun run scripts/clean.js && bun run scripts/clean-node-modules.js
